BUG FIX 2 (reimbursements): POST /api/reimbursements with center-bound staff picks center-bound reimbursement chain. Verified center_id enrichment + chain_id match + approver pending list.
REGRESSION: leave with staff having center_id=None still picks global default chain (chain.center_id is null) — verified by reading the chain doc directly.

FEATURE /me/summary (staff user): includes leave_balances (list) + all_holidays (list, filtered to current year) + upcoming_holidays (<=3). All pre-existing keys (staff, today, month_stats, pending_counts) preserved.

FEATURE /me/summary (NO-staff branch — the just-fixed branch): returns upcoming_holidays:[], all_holidays:[], leave_balances:[] as empty arrays alongside staff:null. Previously these keys were missing.
FEATURE /me/summary leave_balances rows are decorated: row has leave_type_name (matches leave_types.name) and leave_type_color, joined by leave_type_id. Verified after allocating 12 days CL.

FRONTEND /hr-settings Geofences: 'Add Geofence' opens dialog containing data-testid='map-picker'. .leaflet-container mounts. .leaflet-control-attribution contains 'OpenStreetMap'. Clicking map sets latitude and longitude inputs to numeric strings (21.412162, 80.288086 in the test).
FRONTEND /check-in HomeTab: admin login renders without console errors; leave-balances-card visible. toggle-holidays button toggles label between 'SEE ALL (N)' and 'SHOW UPCOMING' on click.

REGRESSION sample: /api/auth/users 200, default chains for leave/reimbursement/transaction/asset_purchase/employee_transfer present, leave-balances/allocate works, center_staff hits 403 on /transactions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 6087 lines — recommend splitting into routers (hrms, finance, approvals, auth, mobile) for maintainability. Not blocking.
Reimbursement POST body schema uses 'date' field (not 'incurred_on') — minor inconsistency with conceptual naming but functional.
seed_data_creation: Per-run UUID suffix used.
